mcp:tool-listener.doc:name: MCP Server - Tool Listener
mcp:tool-listener.name: retrive-empname-by-id
mcp:tool-listener.mcp:description: Retrieve employee name by its ID

logger.message: Entered into retrieve the name of an employee

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json var employees = [ { "empid": "E101", "empname": "Amit Sharma", "contactno": "9876543210", "address": "Hyderabad, Telangana", "salary": 75000, "grade": "A" }, { "empid": "E102", "empname": "Priya Reddy", "contactno": "9123456780", "address": "Bangalore, Karnataka", "salary": 68000, "grade": "B" }, { "empid": "E103", "empname": "Rahul Verma", "contactno": "9988776655", "address": "Pune, Maharashtra", "salary": 72000, "grade": "A" } ] var result = employees filter (e) -> upper(e.empid) == upper(attributes.parameters.empid) --- if (sizeOf(result) > 0) result else {"message": "Employee not found"}
